evidence.reason: `claim_run_dir` creates the record base and then creates `self.run_dir` with `mkdir`, but never fsyncs the record base after adding that directory entry. The later `durable_write` only persists the receipt inside the run directory; it cannot make the run-directory entry in `record_dir` durable. A crash after admission can therefore lose the run directory and its recovery state even though the host is held. The fix belongs at the run-directory creation point, including the record base's parent when the base is newly created.
